description: Get the full details for one learning outcome by outcome_id, including its rating criteria, mastery_points, and calculation_method. The outcome_id comes from list_outcome_group_outcomes, list_outcome_group_links, or get_outcome_results' / get_outcome_rollups' linked.outcomes; get_outcome_alignments lists all alignments in the course (not scoped to one outcome) — cross-reference via get_outcome_results instead to tie an alignment to this outcome_id.

add_defaults.description: Include default mastery colors and levels when Canvas supports it.

name: get_outcome
title: Get Outcome
